title: Ontology-Grounded Project Memory for Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.13662v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents have become the primary means of generating new code in many software projects, and the resulting velocity of changes makes keeping track of the reasons behind those changes challenging. This paper introduces MOOSEDev, a system designed to give coding agents structured, ontology-grounded project memory. The system captures architectural decisions, lessons, constraints, and rationales in a knowledge graph exposed to agents via a Model Context Protocol (MCP) interface. Records carry lifecycle status, provenance, and supersession links, queryable via MOOSE, a proprietary neurosymbolic engine that treats the symbolic layer as the primary reasoning substrate. We compared MOOSEDev against a production vector-memory tool on a neutral public corpus of 835 typed records. translated_title: 基于本体论的项目记忆用于编码代理
translated_abstract: 编码代理已成为许多软件项目中生成新代码的主要手段，由此带来的变更速度使得追踪这些变更背后的原因变得具有挑战性。本文介绍了MOOSEDev，一个旨在为编码代理提供结构化、基于本体论的项目记忆的系统。该系统通过知识图谱捕获架构决策、经验教训、约束条件和理由，并通过模型上下文协议（MCP）接口将这些信息暴露给代理。记录带有生命周期状态、来源和替代链接，可通过MOOSE（一种专有的神经符号引擎）进行查询，该引擎将符号层视为主要推理基质。我们在一个包含835条类型化记录的中性公共语料库上，将MOOSEDev与生产级向量记忆工具进行了比较。在替代、集合完整性和否定问题上，MOOSEDev几乎完整地返回了预期答案集（0.98-1.00），而基线模型的top-k结果则有所欠缺。
tldr: MOOSEDev通过本体论知识图谱和神经符号引擎为编码代理提供结构化项目记忆，在替代、集合完整性和否定查询上显著优于传统向量记忆工具。
en_tdlr: MOOSEDev provides structured, ontology-grounded project memory for coding agents via a knowledge graph and neurosymbolic engine, significantly outperforming traditional vector-memory tools on supersession, set-completeness, and negation queries.
